name: Tuscan Chicken and White Beans
description: Seared chicken thighs in a creamy garlic and sun-dried tomato sauce with white beans, spinach, and parmesan.
recipeIngredient: 2 tbsp olive oil (or oil from the sun-dried tomato jar)
2 cans cannellini beans (15 oz, drained and rinsed)

recipeInstructions.text: Pat chicken thighs dry. Season both sides with salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning.

Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high until shimmering. Sear the thighs smooth side down without moving them until deep golden, 5-6 minutes. Flip and cook 4 minutes more; they won't be cooked through. Move to a plate, working in batches if they crowd.
Lower the heat to medium. Cook yellow onion in the fat with a pinch of salt until soft, 4-5 minutes.
Add garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, tomato paste, and red pepper flakes. Stir until fragrant and the paste darkens, 1-2 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth and scrape up the browned bits. Let it bubble 2 minutes.

Stir in heavy cream and cannellini beans and bring to a gentle simmer. Nestle the chicken back in with its juices. Simmer uncovered until the sauce coats a spoon and the chicken reaches 175°F, 10-12 minutes. Mash a few beans against the pan for a thicker sauce.

Turn off the heat. Stir in baby spinach a handful at a time until wilted. Stir in parmesan and the juice of half a lemon. Taste, adding salt or more lemon until bright. Loosen with a splash of broth if too thick.
Top with basil and extra parmesan. Serve with crusty bread or over rice.
Thighs stay juicy at 175–185°F. Reheat leftovers on the stove with a splash of broth.
